name: What type of visa do I need to buy a house in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What type of visa do I need to buy a house in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not need a specific visa to purchase real estate in Florida as a foreign national. Property ownership does not grant immigration status or residency. However, you will need a valid visa or entry authorization to physically be in the United States for the purchase process, such as a tourist visa. Understanding your visa status helps determine the duration you can stay in the U.S. to manage the transaction and inspect properties.
acceptedAnswer.description: You do not need a specific visa to buy property in Florida, as ownership does not grant residency. However, you will need valid entry authorization to be present for the purchase process.
